name: Native Escalation: five sorties with post-takeoff missile-loss recovery

steps.name: Start hidden native dedicated manager
Native server listens while waiting for players
First client joins native waiting server
First player triggers native mission loading
Second client joins native server
Second native client loads the mission
Native server sees both players
Native server runs large Escalation
Server sees both matching player identities
First player chooses Primeva
Second player chooses Boscali
Server confirms both faction decisions
First player reserves an aircraft
Second player reserves an aircraft
First player receives an owned airframe
Second player receives an owned airframe
First player requests spawning
Second player requests spawning
First client receives its aircraft
Second client receives its aircraft
Server matches both client aircraft identities
First player starts its engine
Second player starts its engine
Inspect aircraft and standard loadouts

Sortie 1: Client 1 confirms selected rocket station

Sortie 1: Client 2 confirms selected rocket station
Sortie 1: Both native clients fly and fire rockets for thirty seconds

Sortie 1: Client 2 ejects during flight
